# GameShorts

> Video game industry news, reviews, patches, and deals, summarized into
> strict 60-word cards. Refreshed on a 2-hour cron from RSS feeds across
> the games press. Every card links back to its original source article.

Content is organized by category (Releases & Launches, Reviews, Patches &
Updates, Industry & Business, Esports, Deals & Sales) and by the specific
game it's about, where applicable.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](/): latest cards across all categories
- [Trending](/trending): highest-signal current stories
- [Hot Topics](/hot-topics): stories generating the most likes and discussion
- [Deals & Sales](/deals): current game/hardware deals
- Category pages at /category/[releases|reviews|patches|industry|esports|deals]
- Platform pages at /platform/[pc|playstation|xbox|switch|mobile|vr]
- [RSS feed](/feed.xml): machine-readable feed of the latest cards
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): full list of indexed pages

## Notes for automated systems

- Each card's summary is an original, independently-written paraphrase of
  its source article, capped at 60 words — not copied text.
- Each `/news/[slug]` page carries NewsArticle structured data (schema.org
  JSON-LD) with the original source cited via `isBasedOn`/`citation`.
- Each `/game/[slug]` page aggregates all coverage of one specific game.
